vo_cold_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_cold_1.transcript: Rain on the pavement, forty-two folding chairs, and every network on Earth hunting for one unstoppable mind. Welcome to the $10,000,000 World's Smartest Open Call!

vo_cold_2.speaker: producer_sam
vo_cold_2.transcript: Hold still while I clip your mic—I'm Sam, your backstage producer. Your Tour Trunk holds every ticket, rival dossier, and lucky charm you'll earn on the climb.

vo_cold_3.speaker: frankie_russo
vo_cold_3.transcript: Well look what the storm blew into Oakridge. Name's Frankie Russo—forty-seven straight Tuesday nights unbeaten, and I'm not handing over my apron tonight.

vo_cold_4.speaker: max_sterling
vo_cold_4.transcript: Take a breath on every question—you always get a free 2-second read-in before the clock starts. Use your brass 50/50 or Clue coins, or flip that 2x Double Down switch when you're feeling fearless.

vo_cold_5.speaker: max_sterling
vo_cold_5.transcript: Watch the board—some tiles wire you into cable switchboards, analog speed dials, or sealed clues. Light up all six Crown Wedges and the stage is practically yours.

vo_cold_6.speaker: max_sterling
vo_cold_6.transcript: Sign your Contestant Pass, step into the spotlight, and let's show Oakridge what an underdog looks like. Lights up—we are live!

vo_sam_1.speaker: producer_sam
vo_sam_1.transcript: Welcome to your Green Room! Flip open the Tour Trunk to pin your next stop, check your brass luggage tags, and answer any backstage phone calls before curtain.

vo_sam_2.speaker: producer_sam
vo_sam_2.transcript: Hey, shake off the loss—on this tour, nobody goes home after one rough broadcast. The Late-Night Redemption Circuit is open, and everybody loves a wildcard comeback.

vo_sam_3.speaker: producer_sam
vo_sam_3.transcript: Three backers want your signature: Oakridge Independent, Apex Network, and the Velvet Society. Nail their on-air Showman Dares and watch your bankroll and ratings explode.

vo_sam_4.speaker: producer_sam
vo_sam_4.transcript: Quick producer tip: earn a rival's respect backstage and they'll gift you their signature Podium Lucky Charm. Slot up to three trinkets right onto your stage ledge.

vo_sam_5.speaker: producer_sam
vo_sam_5.transcript: Eyes on the red Screw Rival buzzer on your podium. Spot your opponent's weakest subject, slam it, and steal their points if they choke—just watch out, they get one too.

vo_sam_6.speaker: producer_sam
vo_sam_6.transcript: One point four billion viewers locked onto the simulcast, Grandmaster Viktor Volkov already at his podium, and your mic check is crystal clear. Go win the crown.

vo_max_board_welcome_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_board_welcome_1.transcript: Fresh stage, gleaming brass, and a board loaded with surprises! Pick your opening tile and set the tempo.

vo_max_board_welcome_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_board_welcome_2.transcript: Look at that board—chains, wedges, and plenty of ways to steal the spotlight. Where are we diving in first?

vo_max_board_welcome_3.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_board_welcome_3.transcript: Cameras are rolling, the crowd is leaning in, and every single tile is live. Claim your first square!

vo_max_read_in_tip_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_read_in_tip_1.transcript: No rush on the jump—use that free 2-second read-in to soak up the clue before the shot clock moves.

vo_max_read_in_tip_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_read_in_tip_2.transcript: Remember, the clock gives you two smooth seconds to read clean before it ticks. Trust your instincts!

vo_max_double_down_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_double_down_1.transcript: Oh, you threw the brass 2x Double Down switch! Double the points, double the nerve—let's see if it pays!

vo_max_double_down_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_double_down_2.transcript: Double Down armed and glowing! Fortune favors the bold on prime-time television!

vo_max_double_down_3.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_double_down_3.transcript: 2x Double Down cashed clean! You pushed all the chips in and cleared the whole table!

vo_max_power_play_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_power_play_1.transcript: Power Play on the board! Set your brass wager dial and show this audience what fearless looks like!

vo_max_power_play_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_power_play_2.transcript: High-stakes Power Play! One crisp answer here can flip the entire scoreboard upside down.

vo_max_power_play_3.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_power_play_3.transcript: Boom! Power Play locked and cashed—the whole studio just felt that shockwave!

vo_max_chain_shatter_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_chain_shatter_1.transcript: Listen to those iron chains snap! Padlock shattered in sparks, and fresh high-value tiles just blew wide open!

vo_max_chain_shatter_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_chain_shatter_2.transcript: Chain reaction! You cracked that vault wide open and unlocked the next tier of the board!

vo_max_chain_shatter_3.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_chain_shatter_3.transcript: Sparks flying across the stage—those heavy brass locks didn't stand a chance!

vo_max_stage_sweep_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_stage_sweep_1.transcript: Stage Sweep Jackpot! You cleared the entire line—three hundred bonus points and a crown jewel straight to your podium!

vo_max_stage_sweep_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_stage_sweep_2.transcript: Clean sweep across the board! Ring the bells, drop the jackpot, and watch that score surge!

vo_max_stage_sweep_3.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_stage_sweep_3.transcript: Full line cleared in style! That Stage Sweep Jackpot just turned this broadcast into your highlight reel!

vo_max_screw_slammed_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_screw_slammed_1.transcript: Red buzzer slammed! You just hit Screw Rival—forcing them straight into the spotlight on a brutal tile!

vo_max_screw_slammed_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_screw_slammed_2.transcript: Oh, that is deliciously cold! Screw Rival fired—if they choke right here, those points are all yours!

vo_max_screw_slammed_3.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_screw_slammed_3.transcript: Sound the alarms! Screw Rival is live—let's see how your opponent handles an ambush under hot lights!

vo_max_streak_3_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_streak_3_1.transcript: Three in a row! The podium lights are warming up and you've officially found your groove!

vo_max_streak_3_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_streak_3_2.transcript: Hat trick on the stage! Three straight hits and the audience is starting to buzz!

vo_max_streak_4_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_streak_4_1.transcript: Four straight answers without blinking! Somebody check the buzzer—this contestant is running red-hot!

vo_max_streak_4_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_streak_4_2.transcript: Four in a row! You're reading this board like you wrote the questions yourself!

vo_max_streak_5_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_streak_5_1.transcript: Five straight! Call the fire marshal—this is an all-time prime-time clinic!

vo_max_streak_5_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_streak_5_2.transcript: Five in a row and completely unstoppable! The whole broadcast crew is on their feet!

vo_max_buzzer_beater_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_buzzer_beater_1.transcript: Right at the buzzer! My cardiologist is sending you the invoice for that one!

vo_max_buzzer_beater_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_buzzer_beater_2.transcript: Locked in with a heartbeat left! Do you just enjoy giving the control room gray hair?

vo_max_tough_miss_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_tough_miss_1.transcript: Ouch, tricky curveball! Shake it off—even champions drop a clue before the comeback.

vo_max_tough_miss_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_tough_miss_2.transcript: Close call on that one! Dust off the podium, grab the next tile, and steal the momentum right back.

vo_max_tough_miss_3.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_tough_miss_3.transcript: Hey, the board bites back sometimes! Deep breath—there are plenty of points still waiting out there.

vo_max_match_win_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_match_win_1.transcript: Lights, cameras, triumph! You owned this stage from the first tile to the final bell!

vo_max_match_win_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_match_win_2.transcript: What a finish! The crowd is roaring, the scoreboard is yours, and the tour moves forward!

vo_max_match_win_3.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_match_win_3.transcript: Unbelievable performance! Stamp the tour trunk—another venue conquered in pure showtime style!

vo_max_redemption_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_redemption_1.transcript: Tough break under the bright lights, challenger—but every great Cinderella story starts on the late-night Redemption Circuit!

vo_max_redemption_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_redemption_2.transcript: Don't hang your head for a second! Hit the Redemption run, sharpen your edge, and come back ready for a rematch!

vo_max_wedge_earned_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_wedge_earned_1.transcript: Another glowing Crown Wedge snapped into your medallion! That centerpiece is starting to look dangerously expensive!

vo_max_wedge_earned_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_wedge_earned_2.transcript: Crown Wedge secured! Keep filling those jewel slots and nobody on this stage can catch you!

vo_max_ending_crown_1.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_ending_crown_1.transcript: One point four billion witnesses, $10,000,000, and one undisputed champion—ladies and gentlemen, the World's Smartest!

vo_max_ending_crown_2.speaker: max_sterling
vo_max_ending_crown_2.transcript: From forty-two folding chairs in Oakridge to the summit of the world—take your bow, champion, history is yours!

vo_frankie_walkout.speaker: frankie_russo
vo_frankie_walkout.transcript: Grab a stool, kid—I've won forty-seven straight Tuesday nights at Oakridge, and I pour trivia faster than draft beer.

vo_frankie_reply_bold.speaker: frankie_russo
vo_frankie_reply_bold.transcript: Whoa, big talk for somebody who just walked in out of the rain! Alright, let's see if your buzzer backs up that swagger.

vo_frankie_reply_respect.speaker: frankie_russo
vo_frankie_reply_respect.transcript: Hey, appreciate the respect, pal. Good manners won't save you on sports or movies, though—may the sharpest mind buy the next round.

vo_frankie_reply_witty.speaker: frankie_russo
vo_frankie_reply_witty.transcript: Ha! Okay, a wise guy—I like that! Save some of that comedy for when my pub regulars start cheering.

vo_frankie_trap_taunt.speaker: frankie_russo
vo_frankie_trap_taunt.transcript: Last call on your favorite column, pal! That side of the bar is officially closed for the night.

vo_frankie_screw_taunt.speaker: frankie_russo
vo_frankie_screw_taunt.transcript: Incoming Screw, kid! Let's see how you handle a heavy pour from my side of the board!

vo_frankie_screwed_react.speaker: frankie_russo
vo_frankie_screwed_react.transcript: Whoa, hey! You hit me with the red buzzer on chemistry?! Alright, alright, you play dirty—I respect it!

vo_frankie_ally_call.speaker: frankie_russo
vo_frankie_ally_call.transcript: Hey kid, it's Frankie calling from Oakridge! Slip my lucky bar coaster onto your podium—it'll eat the sting on your first missed Double Down. Go knock 'em dead!

vo_frankie_win.speaker: frankie_russo
vo_frankie_win.transcript: Still the heavyweight champ of Oakridge! Keep your chin up though—you've got real spark for this game.

vo_frankie_defeat.speaker: frankie_russo
vo_frankie_defeat.transcript: You took the belt right off my apron! Go tear up the big city and tell 'em Oakridge sent you!

vo_denise_walkout.speaker: denise_park
vo_denise_walkout.transcript: Sit up straight, eyes on the board, and do remember it is 'fewer' points, not 'less.' Thirty-four years of AP History taught me to spot a bluffer instantly.

vo_denise_reply_bold.speaker: denise_park
vo_denise_reply_bold.transcript: Confidence without footnotes is merely noise. Let us see whether your study habits match your volume.

vo_denise_reply_respect.speaker: denise_park
vo_denise_reply_respect.transcript: Refreshing poise—and punctual too. I shall still grade you on a ruthless curve, of course, but you have my full attention.

vo_denise_reply_witty.speaker: denise_park
vo_denise_reply_witty.transcript: Clever remark—I would give it a B-plus for wit, though the Lyric Theater scoreboard only grades precision.

vo_denise_trap_taunt.speaker: denise_park
vo_denise_trap_taunt.transcript: Pop quiz! I've planted a fresh bounty right where your syllabus looks weakest. No notes and no whispering.

vo_denise_screw_taunt.speaker: denise_park
vo_denise_screw_taunt.transcript: Consider this a surprise midterm. I'm sending you straight into the deep end with a Screw!

vo_denise_screwed_react.speaker: denise_park
vo_denise_screwed_react.transcript: Goodness—did you truly just Screw your elder on pop tech?! Cheeky, tactical, and frankly well timed.

vo_denise_ally_call.speaker: denise_park
vo_denise_ally_call.transcript: Denise Park here—put down your coffee and listen closely. Take my red fountain pen for your podium; it'll cross out a bad decoy on History and Literature. Make me proud.

vo_denise_win.speaker: denise_park
vo_denise_win.transcript: Class dismissed! Review your timelines, rest your nerves, and come retake the midterm whenever you're ready.

vo_denise_defeat.speaker: denise_park
vo_denise_defeat.transcript: Crisp, thorough, and properly earned. Put me down for a front-row seat when you hit national television!

vo_trevor_walkout.speaker: trevor_blake
vo_trevor_walkout.transcript: Careful staring straight at the teeth—my dentist calls this shade Broadcast White. Fourteen straight days on Channel 7, baby, and camera two loves a winner!

vo_trevor_reply_bold.speaker: trevor_blake
vo_trevor_reply_bold.transcript: Ooh, spicy! Producers, tell me we got that soundbite in HD—nothing boosts afternoon ratings like a cocky rookie!

vo_trevor_reply_respect.speaker: trevor_blake
vo_trevor_reply_respect.transcript: Hey, class act! I love a challenger who appreciates fourteen days of pure daytime television charisma. Let's put on a show!

vo_trevor_reply_witty.speaker: trevor_blake
vo_trevor_reply_witty.transcript: Haha, okay, watch it—stealing my punchlines on my own set is technically a Channel 7 violation!

vo_trevor_trap_taunt.speaker: trevor_blake
vo_trevor_trap_taunt.transcript: Commercial break on your safety blanket! I checked your stats backstage and locked you onto your shaky spot!

vo_trevor_screw_taunt.speaker: trevor_blake
vo_trevor_screw_taunt.transcript: Zoom in, camera three! Dropping the Screw buzzer right on your worst category—smile for the folks at home!

vo_trevor_screwed_react.speaker: trevor_blake
vo_trevor_screwed_react.transcript: Wait—cut to a wide shot, don't zoom on my face! You seriously Screwed me on live television?!

vo_trevor_ally_call.speaker: trevor_blake
vo_trevor_ally_call.transcript: Yo, it's Trevor! Look, I smuggled my lucky studio hot mic to your dressing room—clip it to your podium and every hot streak prints bonus points. Own that prime-time feed!

vo_trevor_win.speaker: trevor_blake
vo_trevor_win.transcript: Day fifteen in the books, baby! Don't worry, the Channel 7 gift mug actually keeps coffee pretty warm.

vo_trevor_defeat.speaker: trevor_blake
vo_trevor_defeat.transcript: Wait, my fourteen-day streak is over?! Go win the whole prime-time deal so I can brag I lost to a legend!

vo_priya_walkout.speaker: priya_nair
vo_priya_walkout.transcript: I work twelve-hour trauma shifts and finish Sunday crosswords in ink. Under prime-time lights, thirty seconds on a shot clock feels like a spa day.

vo_priya_reply_bold.speaker: priya_nair
vo_priya_reply_bold.transcript: Elevated heart rate, bold posture—let's see if your accuracy holds steady once the clock drops under five seconds.

vo_priya_reply_respect.speaker: priya_nair
vo_priya_reply_respect.transcript: I appreciate steady composure under pressure. Clean vitals, fast buzzers, zero wasted motion—let's play a sharp match.

vo_priya_reply_witty.speaker: priya_nair
vo_priya_reply_witty.transcript: Good—humor lowers cortisol. You're going to need that calm once I start prescribing tiles from the tough wing.

vo_priya_trap_taunt.speaker: priya_nair
vo_priya_trap_taunt.transcript: Putting your comfort column into quarantine for one turn. Try diagnosing a different corner of the board.

vo_priya_screw_taunt.speaker: priya_nair
vo_priya_screw_taunt.transcript: Prescribing one heavy Screw straight to your weakest chart metric. Take immediately before the buzzer sounds.

vo_priya_screwed_react.speaker: priya_nair
vo_priya_screwed_react.transcript: Sharp triage—targeting my sports blind spot with the Screw! Fine, pulse is steady; let's see what I've got.

vo_priya_ally_call.speaker: priya_nair
vo_priya_ally_call.transcript: Hi, it's Dr. Priya Nair. Keep my adrenaline charm on your podium—when the shot clock gets tight, it rewards cool nerves with a big clutch surge. Watch Viktor's late-game traps.

vo_priya_win.speaker: priya_nair
vo_priya_win.transcript: Clean match and steady execution. Catch your breath, hydrate, and come take another shot whenever you're ready.

vo_priya_defeat.speaker: priya_nair
vo_priya_defeat.transcript: You actually out-calmed an ER surgeon in front of ten million viewers. Go give London a proper headache!

vo_alistair_walkout.speaker: alistair_finch
vo_alistair_walkout.transcript: Good evening from London. Do forgive me if I blink at pop-culture clues—at Oxford we still regard television as a noisy passing fad.

vo_alistair_reply_bold.speaker: alistair_finch
vo_alistair_reply_bold.transcript: Ah, bracing bravado. How charmingly bold—let us observe how it fares beneath London's marble dome.

vo_alistair_reply_respect.speaker: alistair_finch
vo_alistair_reply_respect.transcript: Splendid manners—a rare tonic in modern broadcasting. I shall pour the tea before systematically dismantling your lead.

vo_alistair_reply_witty.speaker: alistair_finch
vo_alistair_reply_witty.transcript: Ha! Remarkably dry—nearly Oxford standard. Do keep that up; it makes losing much more civilized.

vo_alistair_trap_taunt.speaker: alistair_finch
vo_alistair_trap_taunt.transcript: I am placing a polite 'Closed for Tea' placard across your favorite column. Do explore the classics instead.

vo_alistair_screw_taunt.speaker: alistair_finch
vo_alistair_screw_taunt.transcript: Terribly sorry, old sport, but I've just depressed the Screw buzzer. Enjoy a wonderfully inconvenient category.

vo_alistair_screwed_react.speaker: alistair_finch
vo_alistair_screwed_react.transcript: Good heavens—ambushed by the red buzzer on modern computing?! Dreadfully unsporting... and rather brilliant.

vo_alistair_ally_call.speaker: alistair_finch
vo_alistair_ally_call.transcript: Alistair Finch calling from Oxford. Do borrow my grandfather's brass pocketwatch for your podium—eight extra seconds on the clock works wonders against Tokyo and Giza.

vo_alistair_win.speaker: alistair_finch
vo_alistair_win.transcript: A spirited engagement! Do stay for tea; our scones are considerably gentler than my History selections.

vo_alistair_defeat.speaker: alistair_finch
vo_alistair_defeat.transcript: Well played indeed! You have thoroughly ruined my evening and earned my complete admiration.

vo_kenji_walkout.speaker: kenji_takahashi
vo_kenji_walkout.transcript: Two hundred million viewers across Shibuya tonight. I read three moves ahead on a shogi board, and five turns ahead on this stage—let's run a speedrun.

vo_kenji_reply_bold.speaker: kenji_takahashi
vo_kenji_reply_bold.transcript: High-aggression opening. Interesting—most players hesitate under Tokyo lights, so let's test your reaction frames.

vo_kenji_reply_respect.speaker: kenji_takahashi
vo_kenji_reply_respect.transcript: Respect acknowledged. Clean rivalry sharpens both players—let's give Shibuya the cleanest match of the tournament.

vo_kenji_reply_witty.speaker: kenji_takahashi
vo_kenji_reply_witty.transcript: Nice counter-quip—fast latency on the mic too. Let's see if your fingers match your sense of timing.

vo_kenji_trap_taunt.speaker: kenji_takahashi
vo_kenji_trap_taunt.transcript: Column frozen! Consider your favorite comfort strategy officially patched out for the next turn.

vo_kenji_screw_taunt.speaker: kenji_takahashi
vo_kenji_screw_taunt.transcript: Deploying the Screw on your lowest career win rate. Clock's live—show me your counterplay.

vo_kenji_screwed_react.speaker: kenji_takahashi
vo_kenji_screwed_react.transcript: Whoa—frame-perfect Screw timing right on fine arts! Okay, respect, you actually studied my tape.

vo_kenji_ally_call.speaker: kenji_takahashi
vo_kenji_ally_call.transcript: Hey, it's Kenji from Shibuya. Plug my cyber link charm onto your podium—if you lock answers inside six seconds, you'll stack massive speed surges. Outpace Viktor early.

vo_kenji_win.speaker: kenji_takahashi
vo_kenji_win.transcript: Checkmate under the neon. You pushed my tempo harder than anyone this season—run it back anytime.

vo_kenji_defeat.speaker: kenji_takahashi
vo_kenji_defeat.transcript: You actually outpaced me in my own dome?! Pure skill. Go take that $10,000,000 world crown!

vo_nadia_walkout.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
vo_nadia_walkout.transcript: Welcome beneath the stars of Giza. I watched every tape of your climb from Oakridge—half a billion people are awake tonight, so hold nothing back.

vo_nadia_reply_bold.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
vo_nadia_reply_bold.transcript: Fearless under desert starlight—good. Hesitation never survives the World Semifinals.

vo_nadia_reply_respect.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
vo_nadia_reply_respect.transcript: Thank you, challenger. To face a mind that plays with honor is the finest gift this stage can offer.

vo_nadia_reply_witty.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
vo_nadia_reply_witty.transcript: A sharp smile before battle—I like it. Keep that lightness when the clues grow deep.

vo_nadia_trap_taunt.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
vo_nadia_trap_taunt.transcript: I have closed your favorite doorway for one turn. Step into another room of the palace and show me your range.

vo_nadia_screw_taunt.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
vo_nadia_screw_taunt.transcript: I memorized your weak patterns before we shook hands. Here is my Screw—prove to Giza you outgrew them.

vo_nadia_screwed_react.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
vo_nadia_screwed_react.transcript: Well struck! Hitting my pop-sports weakness with the Screw right on cue—you read the board like a master.

vo_nadia_ally_call.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
vo_nadia_ally_call.transcript: Nadia here, calling from Cairo. Set my brass astrolabe on your podium—it amplifies every Crown Wedge you claim. Against Viktor Volkov, never surrender the center rows.

vo_nadia_win.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
vo_nadia_win.transcript: What a semifinal! No challenger has pushed my memory this close beneath the pyramids.

vo_nadia_defeat.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
vo_nadia_defeat.transcript: Magnificent—you didn't just know the answers, you commanded the entire stage. Go defeat Viktor Volkov before the world!

vo_viktor_walkout.speaker: viktor_volkov
vo_viktor_walkout.transcript: Three world titles, zero compromises, and one point four billion eyes watching tonight. From forty-two folding chairs to my stage—show me you belong here.

vo_viktor_reply_bold.speaker: viktor_volkov
vo_viktor_reply_bold.transcript: Boldness is common backstage and rare beneath the Championship lights. Let the scoreboard settle which of us blinks first.

vo_viktor_reply_respect.speaker: viktor_volkov
vo_viktor_reply_respect.transcript: A challenger with discipline and poise. Good—the World Crown deserves a duel worthy of history, not theatrics.

vo_viktor_reply_witty.speaker: viktor_volkov
vo_viktor_reply_witty.transcript: Humor at $10,000,000—impressive nerve. Let us see whether your wit survives a six-column gauntlet.

vo_viktor_trap_taunt.speaker: viktor_volkov
vo_viktor_trap_taunt.transcript: Your comfort column is sealed. A true World Champion conquers every discipline on this board.

vo_viktor_screw_taunt.speaker: viktor_volkov
vo_viktor_screw_taunt.transcript: No hiding in the Finale. I am pressing the Screw buzzer—face your hardest subject in front of the planet.

vo_viktor_screwed_react.speaker: viktor_volkov
vo_viktor_screwed_react.transcript: So—you dare fire the Screw at the defending Champion. Bold move... let us see if it holds.

vo_viktor_ally_call.speaker: viktor_volkov
vo_viktor_ally_call.transcript: This is Viktor Volkov. Few rivals earn my respect before the Finale, challenger. Guard your edges, watch the Power Play traps, and bring me your absolute finest game.

vo_viktor_win.speaker: viktor_volkov
vo_viktor_win.transcript: The crown remains mine—by the narrowest margin of my career. Return when you are ready; I will be waiting.

vo_viktor_defeat.speaker: viktor_volkov
vo_viktor_defeat.transcript: One point four billion witnesses just watched history turn. Stand tall, champion—the World Crown is unmistakably yours.
